title: Gateway event stream
responsibility: Connects session events to a Responses-style server-sent event response and cancels unfinished sessions when the client disconnects.

inputs.name: gatewayStream.session
inputs.description: The mutable gateway session that receives the stream's `emit` callback. A `done` or `error` event stores the captured event stream in `session.replays` only when `context` is present, and terminal events or client cancellation clear the callback.

inputs.name: gatewayStream.repository
inputs.description: The repository whose `cancel(session)` method is called when the context signal aborts before a terminal event or when the client cancels an unfinished stream. Cancellation is not attempted after `done` or `error` has marked the stream ended.

inputs.name: gatewayStream.context
inputs.description: Optional replay key and abort signal read when the stream starts. A future abort event invokes `repository.cancel(session)` once if the stream is unfinished (an already-aborted signal is not checked), and a terminal event stores the captured stream under `key`; omitting the context skips both behaviors.

outputs.name: gatewayStream
outputs.description: A `Response` with `Content-Type: text/event-stream` and `Cache-Control: no-store` whose body emits UTF-8 server-sent event chunks. It sends serializer startup events, then text/call events, and on `done` or `error` sends the corresponding terminal events, closes and clears `session.emit`, and saves the snapshot when `context` exists; client cancellation cancels only an unfinished session, while signal abort cancels without closing the stream.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: An expected CLI failure propagated from code invoked while producing or emitting the gateway stream. The function does not catch or translate it.
